answer: Here an account is a promise of future work. The ledger tests that promise each epoch with a new crystal and a jury of peers. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the ivory of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the ledge behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 15el8.
